landing.title: Sick abroad?
landing.subtitle: CareCompass doesn't diagnose you. It navigates you. Find local medication equivalents, nearby pharmacies, and overcome language barriers in seconds.
landing.problem: Finding care isn't hard. Explaining symptoms is.
landing.card1Desc: You know Tylenol, but what if you're in Tokyo? Or Mumbai? We map active ingredients to local brands.
landing.card2Desc: Google Translate lacks medical context. We generate a tailored interpreter card for your exact situation.
landing.card3Desc: Should you go to a pharmacy or a hospital? We help you determine the right escalation level, safely.
landing.navigationDesc: Most health apps try to tell you what you have. CareCompass tells you what to do next. We don't replace doctors. We help you find them, talk to them, and understand the medicine they prescribe.
landing.disclaimer: CareCompass provides healthcare navigation guidance and is not a medical diagnosis service. For emergencies or severe conditions, contact local emergency services immediately.

session.title: How are you feeling?
session.subtitle: We'll help you figure out the next steps. No diagnoses, just navigation.

commandCenter.stayHydratedDesc: Sip water or oral rehydration solution.
commandCenter.getRestDesc: Give your body time to recover before strenuous activity.
commandCenter.monitorSymptomsDesc: Seek care if fever rises, pain worsens, or new symptoms appear.
